subject: URGENT: Your account will be suspended in 24 hours
summary: Email claiming to be Northwind Bank threatens account suspension in 24 hours unless the reader verifies identity via a link.
reason: Looks like phishing: sender domain northwind-bank-verify.example is not the bank's own domain, and it pressures the reader to follow a link.

messages.body_text:
Dear Customer,

We detected unusual activity. Your account will be SUSPENDED in 24 hours unless you verify your identity at http://northwind-bank-verify.example/login immediately.

Northwind Security
